Modal — dialogZoom

Every button opens a modal whose panel grows out of the button itself and shrinks back into it on close (X, backdrop click, Esc). Compare with the last one, which has no dialogZoom.

Zoom — default

Full-width panel at the top of the page, zoomed from the button.

Zoom — center medium

Half-width panel centered in the viewport.

Zoom — mini

Compact panel.

Zoom — right

Side panel on the right.

Zoom — top level

Opened with showModal(), on the top layer: Esc still zooms back into the button.

Zoom — slow

Same animation with --modal-zoom-timing: 900ms, to watch it frame by frame.

No zoom

The same modal without dialogZoom.

Zoom from a button far down the page

The panel must start from the button wherever it sits on screen.

From the corner

Grows out of the button on the right.

Reusable frontend components.
